messages:
zoe_cs: Pinwheel flagged a burst of 429s during their midnight canary in eu-west. Spike ~460 clients within 30s.

zoe_cs: Their simple edge snippet: ```POST /v1/sdk/init HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
x-request-id: pin-boot-901
Response: 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 11
```

pinwheel-ops: They run a Cloudflare + small edge worker tier; our browser SDK is used with default opts. Current bootstrap: `Redwood.init({ envKey: 'pk_pin_live', ephemeralTTL: 10 })`. No init jitter.

mike_sdk: Immediate customer guidance: increase ephemeralTTL to at least 120s (prefer 180s) to reduce auth churn; add randomized init jitter (50-800ms) during rollouts; and ensure the edge honors keep-alive so connections are reused.

hitendra_eng: Also ask them to avoid simultaneous full-roll restarts. Stagger the rollout (5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%) and add a small per-instance startup delay.

edge-bot: Observed auth validation QPS for account pinwheel peaked at 3.9k; auth queue latency spiked for short window at 2026-03-23T04:12Z. Dedupe opportunity: coalesce identical token validations originating within 5s.

hitendra_eng: Short-term infra: I can enable a per-account coalescing flag that groups identical ephemeral token checks for 10s. Will scope to Pinwheel for a 20m window.

onboard-bot: Ticket CS-#5017 created: "Pinwheel init fanout 429s". Assigned to hitendra_eng, mike_sdk. Flag request noted.

mike_sdk: Sample patch for Pinwheel's frontend to add jitter + TTL: ```const jitter = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.floor(Math.random()*ms)))
await jitter(800)
await Redwood.init({ envKey: 'pk_pin_live', ephemeralTTL: 180, prefetch: true })```

zoe_cs: I'll ask them to run a 10% canary with TTL=180 + jitter and report any x-request-id values if 429s persist.

pinwheel-ops: Starting canary now with 10% + jitter. Will hold at 10% for 3m then proceed if green.

hitendra_eng: If 429s continue after client-side mitigations, collect two request ids from the failure window and a `x-active-clients` header dump so we can correlate with auth queue traces and consider a short-lived per-account burst cap.

mike_sdk: Long-term SDK proposal: add `initSplayMs`, `ephemeralDefaultSeconds`, and `prefetchConcurrency` controls and ship a small migration guide for rollouts. Filing a GH issue.

zoe_cs: Adding this to Pinwheel's account health note. Will update when canary completes. :white_check_mark:
